deltaReview.durability: Both sanitized before/after cleanup objects emit immediately as JSON with flush. Emit and collector exceptions do not replace primary failure, cleanup result or stage evidence.
deltaReview.normalization: ANSI CSI stripped; quoted strings, matched URL/path/assignment tokens and unknown words redacted. Fixed-vocabulary words or Rust Edddd code shapes only, at most 48 tokens and 240 characters.
deltaReview.retainedBounds: 128 KiB regular-file tail and 16 retained records per snapshot. No arbitrary raw line, source context, pathname, quoted value, argv, environment or exception message is emitted.
deltaReview.meaning: Canonical allowlisted wording, not verbatim diagnostic text or a failure-cause verdict.
deltaReview.portableCoverage: Durable JSON phase order/snapshot equality, ANSI/value redaction, throwing collector and cleanup-only chronology.

macGates.scope: First ESRCH injected only; subsequent full BSD/task queries use the actual owned child and must recover same-birth measured counters.
Real live BSD snapshot followed by pipe-gated exact child exit and WNOWAIT; require real same-birth authoritative zombie and exact child reap.
720 forked children under unchanged resource monitor; at least three complete samples, no terminal monitor failure, verified group cleanup and exact leader reap.
Deliberate clang -fsyntax-only source error must preserve nonzero-exit, emit classified before/after JSON without the private sentinel and verify cleanup.

naturalObservationLimit: naturalRaceObserved aggregates returned final-sample rechecks only; partial-sample rechecks are not counted. Zero does not prove no natural race occurred. Historical race recreation is not required for the controlled ABI/lifecycle gate.

route.treeVsRuntimeBase: Prior full-validation workflow plus this diagnostic workflow; the former does not match this diagnostic branch.

portable.provenance: Recorded in the immutable preparation manifest; full suite not rerun by reviewer.

reviewerChecks: Full delta and four actual-Mac gate implementations
Resource/plan/helper/harness byte equality to reviewed base
Provider caller commit/tree and workflow/source/preparation bytes
Other workflow triggers and branch-run lookup
validation.candidateMacExecution: NOT_EXECUTED at review time; seven actual-Mac tests remain skipped on Linux.

acceptanceBeforeFullValidation: All 118 actual-Mac tests pass without skips or meaningful unresolved findings.
Actual-clang-error before-cleanup and after-cleanup failureExcerpt JSON events are present in job output with expected classification.
Private compiler sentinel and prohibited values are absent from public emitted evidence.
Controlled injection and final-sample natural observations retain their stated limits.
Current official SDK metadata/expiry must be rechecked at acquisition for the separately pinned full validation.
remainingScope: No full host/XUL completion or native authentication is established by this gate.
Persistent, permission and invalid resource uncertainty must remain fail-closed.
